dct_description_sm:
Highlight Tables provide information highlights by topic via key indicators for various levels of geography. Highlight Tables are available for the following topics:

  • Aboriginal peoples
  • Age and sex
  • Education
  • Families, households and marital status
  • Housing
  • Immigration and ethnocultural diversity
  • Income
  • Labour
  • Language
  • Population and dwelling counts
  • Type of dwelling
